records.section: Grade 2 — as-built: content + "The Wrong Name" / 3. The game: "The Wrong Name" / 3.1 Premise — the fair-play moral twist
records.requirementOrFinding: A school award medal has vanished from its glass case at Birchwood school. Student detectives **Mina & Theo** (the "Question Club") investigate. The apparent crime is a **theft** — but the fair-play twist is that it was done **to right an earlier injustice**: last year's science-medal was engraved with the **wrong name**. **Dani** was recorded as the winner, but the numbers show **Lena** actually placed first (Lena's score 9 > Dani's 7); Dani had quietly put his own name first. **Ben**, Lena's older brother, took the medal and left a new one bearing Lena's correct name — not to steal, but to surface the truth. The "culprit" is sympathetic; the real wrong is the original falsified record. The case closes with Lena's name restored, and apologies from both Ben and Dani.
